apiKeys.title: Access keys
apiKeys.intro: Give a script, a CI or an AI agent (Claude…) access to this account only, limited to the sites and rights you choose. A key never exceeds your own rights and stops working if you lose them.
apiKeys.loadFailed: The keys could not be loaded
apiKeys.saveFailed: The key could not be saved
apiKeys.deleteFailed: The key could not be revoked
apiKeys.deleteConfirm: Revoke "{{name}}"? Every script or agent using it loses access at once.
apiKeys.inactiveScope: Inactive: the creator no longer holds this right
apiKeys.inactiveHint: Some rights are inactive: the key creator no longer holds them.
apiKeys.selectedSites: Only the sites below (+ the ones it creates)
apiKeys.noSiteYet: No site yet (only the ones it will create)
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.neverHint: Never granted to a key: deleting a site, a database it did not create or a database server, adding a root domain, other accounts, users.
apiKeys.shownOnce: This key is shown only now: copy it somewhere safe. It cannot be displayed again (revoke it and create another one if lost).
apiKeys.docHint: API: /api/v1 (sites, files, publish, releases, logs). MCP: the same tools for an AI agent. Every action is logged in the audit log with the key name.

read.label: Read files
read.hint: List and read the files of its sites (code and data).

write.label: Write files
write.hint: Create, replace, move, delete, extract archives in its sites.

publish.label: Publish
publish.hint: Publish the code as a new release (live) and roll back.

manage.label: Site settings
manage.hint: Change the settings of its sites: name, docroot, publish mode, PHP, environment variables, data paths, secondary runtimes.

create.label: Create sites
create.hint: Create sites in the account: they join the key automatically.

subdomain.label: Subdomains
subdomain.hint: Attach to its sites subdomains of a domain already in the account (never a new domain): only under the domains given to the key or, for a key limited to some sites, under domains serving its sites alone. Removes only the ones it created, and not one that also serves a site outside the key.

read.label: Read logs
read.hint: Access / error / application logs of its sites.

manage.label: Cron jobs
manage.hint: Schedule commands of its sites (create, change, run, read the output).

manage.label: Databases
manage.hint: Database servers of the account, databases and users (all of them for a key on every site, only its own otherwise); deletes only what it created.

manage.label: Routes
manage.hint: Choose which of its sites (or runtime of a site) serves a path of a domain, e.g. example.com/uploads/; only on the domains given to the key or, for a key limited to some sites, on domains serving its sites alone. A route towards a site outside the key is never changed or removed.

apiKeys.guideIntro: Give this file to your AI agent (e.g. "read this guide, then work on my site"): it explains how to connect with a key, develop in staging, publish at the end and roll back. Agents connected through MCP can also read it with the get_guide tool.
apiKeys.guideHint: Read the guide, or download it to give it to your agent

connector.intro: Claude connector: plug this account into Claude (claude.ai, Claude Desktop, mobile) as a custom connector, without pasting a key — you approve the connection here, and can end it at any time.
connector.formHint: Choose what Claude may do. Whoever approves the connection lends their own rights, within these: a member without a right does not pass it on.
connector.secretOnce: The client secret is shown only now. Lost? Generate a new one from the list (the connections in place stay).
connector.step1: In Claude (claude.ai or the Desktop app): Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
connector.step2: Name: Oblimint. Remote MCP server URL: the address below.
connector.step3: Open « Advanced settings » and paste the OAuth Client ID and Client Secret.
connector.step4: Click Add, then Connect: this panel opens and asks you to approve. The connector then works in every Claude app of your Claude account.
connector.teamHint: Claude Team / Enterprise: an owner adds the connector for the organization, then each member connects with their own panel account.
connector.noConnection: Not connected yet: add it in Claude, then approve it here.
connector.rotateConfirm: Generate a new client secret for "{{name}}"? The current one stops at once (to paste again in Claude if it reconnects); live connections stay.
connector.disconnectOne: End this connection? Claude loses access until it is authorized again.
connector.disconnectAll: End every connection of "{{name}}"? Claude loses access until it is authorized again.

apiKeys.domainsHint: With the Routes right, the key may decide which of its sites serves these domains (or a path of them) — even a domain that serves nothing yet; with the Subdomains right, it attaches subdomains under them. A key valid for every site only works on the domains given here. Without a domain here, a key limited to some sites works only on the domains serving its sites alone (subdomains under those same domains). A route towards a site outside the key is never changed or removed. Giving domains needs the domain management right.
apiKeys.notHeldHint: You do not hold this right on the account: you cannot grant it.
apiKeys.domainsNotHeld: You do not hold the domain management right on the account: you cannot give domains to a key.

presets.label: Preset

readonly.label: Read only
readonly.hint: Reads the files and the logs of the chosen sites; writes nothing.

update.label: Updates only
update.hint: For a CI: writes the files and publishes them. No site setting (publish mode, environment, data paths), cron job, database, route or subdomain. On a site in automatic publication the writes go live at once, and so do the files written in the data area.

site.label: Manage one site
site.hint: Everything on exactly one site: files, publication, settings, logs, databases, cron jobs, routes of the domains serving it alone. No site creation, no subdomain, no domain given.

multisite.label: Manage several sites
multisite.hint: The same rights on several sites, or on every site. No domain given by default: give some below only if the key must route them.

autonomous.label: Autonomous creation
autonomous.hint: Creates its own sites and works on them alone (no existing site): files, publication, settings, logs, databases, subdomains attached to its sites. The domains given below only serve as parents of its subdomains. No path route (it would also route the domains given, over the sites they serve); cron jobs (they run code) are to tick apart.

all.label: Everything
all.hint: Every right you may grant, on every site, and every domain if you may give them. Never: deleting a site, adding a root domain, users, other keys.

custom.label: Custom
custom.hint: Rights, sites and domains chosen one by one.

presets.pickSites: Choose two sites or more below, or every site.
presets.pickSite: Choose at least one site below.
presets.pickParents: Choose below the domains it will create its subdomains under.

oauth.title: Connect an application
oauth.request: {{client}} asks to use the connector « {{name}} » on the hosting account {{account}}.
oauth.readOnly: Only read the sites (no right of the connector is held by your account).
oauth.missing: Left out, your account does not hold them: {{list}}.
oauth.asUser: It acts as you ({{user}}), never beyond your own rights; every action is in the audit log. End it at any time from Access keys.
oauth.loadFailed: The authorization request could not be read.

errors.oauthInvalidClient: This connector does not exist any more, has expired or its account is being deleted.
errors.oauthInvalidRedirect: This application is not allowed to use an Oblimint connector.
errors.oauthInvalidRequest: The authorization request is incomplete (PKCE missing).
errors.oauthNoAccess: Your account has no access to the hosting account of this connector: sign in with an account that has.
